ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution towards low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming high-contrast markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous dark region across the entire fluke surface. Discrete, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) and small circular white clusters (spots) are distributed non-uniformly across both lobes, with higher density on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a defined vertex; interior angle is approximately 75 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (fine teeth) along the majority of the trailing edge. A significant, irregular macro-indentation is present on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical outward sweep from the median notch, following a slightly convex curve that terminates at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast, textured white/tan pixels at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization. Multiple small, isolated circular white spots scattered across the central lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths and orientations across the majority of the black ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep irregular notch/defect on the trailing edge of the left lobe, positioned approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip. Calcified-appearing clusters at both lobe tips.
